company.name: LiveControl
company.shortDescription: Using AI and Machine Learning, LiveControl is moving the decades old video production process into the cloud.
company.description: LiveControl is moving the decades-old video production process into the cloud. With AI and Machine Learning, we empower users to live stream and capture beautiful content with the click of a button. From top universities and jazz clubs, to broadway theater, people use LiveControl to automate, collaborate, and control their production from all over the world.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $30,000,000, or 90.36% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,932,797 to $142,463,866, a 10.23x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
